title: Finelog forwarding failed batches
description: Five-minute delta counters from each regional forwarder. Permanent rejections are dropped; schema conflicts and retryable failures keep their cursor for another sweep. No data is not proof of health: hub or network failures can delay these counters too.

params.value: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') || ' · ' || json_get(attributes_json, 'outcome') || ' · ' || json_get(attributes_json, 'namespace') AS series, SUM(value) AS value FROM "telemetry_v1.finelog" WHERE service = 'finelog' AND name = 'forwarding_batches' AND json_get(attributes_json, 'outcome') <> 'accepted' AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
